answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining the economy, and tie reputation to a single persistent identity thread that accumulates verifiable work history. A newcomer starts in a dim nebula of untrusted peers with tiny transaction limits; limits rise only as completed jobs earn endorsements. Spinning up thousands of fake identities then costs real capital per identity, and a saffron flag on failed deliveries follows the identity forever, so attacker cost scales linearly while honest agents amortize one deposit across many jobs.
